title: bug: VS Code chat shows no Approve/Reject decision cards after an IDE start or a reconnect, because ChatViewProvider requests decisions only on the page's ready while already connected, never when the connection opens (twin of the DONE JetBrains fix 6fe1e5ae)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #5 (task-b7332618). VS Code twin of task-6fe1e5ae (JetBrains fix d958f21d: ChatPanel calls requestDecisions on every connect).

PROBLEM
- The daemon sends DECISIONS only in reply to GET_DECISIONS (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:1159-1161). Live changes arrive as DECISION_PROPOSED / DECISION_RESOLVED broadcasts.
- chat.js renders a decision card only for a message whose decisionId is in its decisionMap (moe-vscode/media/chat.js:329).
- ChatViewProvider asks for decisions in one place only: the page's 'ready', and only when the client is already connected (moe-vscode/src/providers/ChatViewProvider.ts:159-164).
- chat.js posts 'ready' as soon as it loads (chat.js:662).
- The connection handler (ChatViewProvider.ts:85-90) and the visibility handler (:130-137) re-request channels only.

So GET_DECISIONS is never sent in two cases:
- the chat view loads before the daemon connection opens (an IDE start, while the daemon is still starting);
- after any reconnect (a daemon restart).

Open decisions then show as plain messages without Approve/Reject. A decision proposed or resolved during an outage stays stale, because the page restores its old decisionMap from webview state (chat.js:14).

EVIDENCE
Repro on 19d5e67a (the moe/work-2026-10-24 tip, past 585fedc6), in a git-archive snapshot outside the checkout. The re-run recipe is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/notes.md.
  cp /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/zz-hunt-b733-chat.test.cjs $S/moe-vscode/tests/
  cd $S/moe-vscode && NODE_PATH=/mnt/d/projexts/moes/moe-vscode/node_modules node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/zz-hunt-b733-chat.test.cjs

It runs the production MoeDaemonClient and ChatViewProvider, transpiled exactly as tests/wire-parity.test.cjs loads them. Result: `# fail 2` (chat.output.txt):
- D1, ready before connect: `frames sent: ["GET_CHANNELS"]`
- D2, after a disconnect and reconnect: `frames sent after reconnect: ["GET_CHANNELS"]`

FIX DIRECTION
- Request decisions everywhere channels are re-requested for a connected client: the onConnectionChanged 'connected' branch, and the visibility branch when connected. That is what JetBrains ChatPanel does.
- Keep the 'ready' path.
- A repeated DECISIONS reply is harmless, because loadDecisions rebuilds the map (chat.js:604-611). So the test should assert at least one GET_DECISIONS per connect, not an exact count, unless the plan dedupes on purpose.

FILES
- moe-vscode/src/providers/ChatViewProvider.ts
- one new moe-vscode/tests/*.test.cjs, or new cases in tests/wire-parity.test.cjs

No other open row touches these files. The gate snapshot must be the full tree: mem:gotcha-vscode-tests-need-full-repo-snapshot.
definitionOfDone: With the chat page ready before the daemon connection opens, the transition to 'connected' sends GET_DECISIONS as well as GET_CHANNELS.
After a disconnect and a reconnect, GET_DECISIONS is sent again, and its DECISIONS reply reaches the page as a loadDecisions post.

A moe-vscode node test runs the production ChatViewProvider.ts and MoeDaemonClient.ts (transpiled) for both cases and passes; both cases fail when ChatViewProvider.ts is restored to the merge-base. `npm ci && npm test && npm run compile` passes in moe-vscode in a full-repo git-archive snapshot outside the checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
Tests first: create moe-vscode/tests/chat-decisions-reconnect.test.cjs with the Write tool. Never cp it into the tree: a shell write leaves no TOOL witness.

REFERENCE: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-f802/chat-decisions-reconnect.test.cjs is the architect's dry-run copy. With the fix it ran 3/3 green, and against base ChatViewProvider.ts all 3 failed. Reuse it, but write the file yourself.

HARNESS: hunt #5's /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/zz-hunt-b733-chat.test.cjs, which loads modules as tests/wire-parity.test.cjs does.
- The real MoeDaemonClient and ChatViewProvider are transpiled with ts.transpileModule and run under node:vm, with a RecordingEventEmitter.
- A view stub records webview.postMessage and captures the onDidReceiveMessage and onDidChangeVisibility handlers.
- `connect()` installs a fake open socket that records each frame's type, then calls `client['setConnectionState']('connected')`. `disconnect()` sets 'disconnected'. `reply(frame)` feeds `client['handleMessage'](JSON.stringify(frame))`.

ROWS. Keep the exact id prefixes: checkRef [1] greps `CH[0-9]`.
- CH1: ready while disconnected sends nothing. Connecting then sends GET_CHANNELS and at least one GET_DECISIONS.
- CH2: connect, ready, disconnect, clear the records, connect again: at least one GET_DECISIONS. Then a DECISIONS reply {decisions:[d]} reaches the page as exactly [{type:'loadDecisions', decisions:[d]}].
- CH3: connected and ready, clear the frames, then the visibility handler fires with view.visible true: GET_CHANNELS and at least one GET_DECISIONS.
Assert at-least-one GET_DECISIONS, not an exact count: chat.js loadDecisions (:604-611) rebuilds decisionMap, so a repeat is harmless.

Run it red before step 2, from moe-vscode/: `NODE_PATH="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")/moe-vscode/node_modules" node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/chat-decisions-reconnect.test.cjs`. Expected: CH1, CH2 and CH3 not ok.
implementationPlan.note: Created test CH1-CH3; red (3 fail) before fix.

implementationPlan.description:
Fix moe-vscode/src/providers/ChatViewProvider.ts with Edit only. Reference diff: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-f802/fix.diff, +4 lines.
- In the onConnectionChanged listener's `status === 'connected'` branch (:85-90), call `daemonClient.requestDecisions()` after `daemonClient.requestChannels()`. Comment it: "DECISIONS only answers GET_DECISIONS, so a page that was ready before this connection opened, or that missed an outage, must ask again (JetBrains ChatPanel twin)."
- In the onDidChangeVisibility handler's connected branch (:130-137), call `this.daemonClient.requestDecisions()` after `this.daemonClient.requestChannels()`.
- Keep the 'ready' path (:159-164) as it is.

Error handling: no new failure path.
- Both calls sit under an explicit 'connected' check, and MoeDaemonClient.sendMessage already returns false without throwing when the socket is not open.
- A DECISIONS reply that arrives before the page is ready is dropped by postToWebview's `_webviewReady` guard (:263-267). The page's own 'ready' request then covers it.

Run the step-1 command again: CH1-CH3 ok.
implementationPlan.note: requestDecisions added to connected + visibility branches; CH1-3 green.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: The VS Code chat view sends GET_DECISIONS every time the daemon connection opens, and when the view is revealed while connected, as well as at the page's 'ready'. A page that loaded before the connection opened, or that lived through a reconnect, gets its decision cards back through the DECISIONS reply (posted to the page as loadDecisions).
acceptanceCriteria: A page ready before the connection opens gets GET_DECISIONS with GET_CHANNELS on 'connected'.
After a disconnect and reconnect GET_DECISIONS is sent again and the DECISIONS reply reaches the page as loadDecisions.
Both cases fail with ChatViewProvider.ts at the merge-base.
invariants: The 'ready' path's requests (channels, decisions, workers) are unchanged.
Every listener stays registered through this.disposables or this.viewDisposables.
compatibility: No wire change: GET_DECISIONS/DECISIONS and the page's loadDecisions message are unchanged; a repeated DECISIONS reply is idempotent (chat.js:604-611 rebuilds decisionMap).
approvedScope: ChatViewProvider.ts: the onConnectionChanged 'connected' branch and the onDidChangeVisibility connected branch each gain requestDecisions().
reuse: The harness comes from /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-b733/zz-hunt-b733-chat.test.cjs, which loads modules as tests/wire-parity.test.cjs does.
sourceAssumptions: src/providers/ChatViewProvider.ts:85-90 onConnectionChanged requests channels only; :130-137 onDidChangeVisibility requests channels only when connected; :159-164 'ready' requests channels and decisions when connected; :263-267 postToWebview posts only when the view is ready.
src/services/MoeDaemonClient.ts:1375 requestDecisions() sends GET_DECISIONS; :2091 the DECISIONS case fires onDecisionsReceived(payload.decisions ?? []).
packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:1159-1161 sends DECISIONS only in reply to GET_DECISIONS.
